program.name: Fighter Power
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Power for punches and kicks: explosive push-ups and swings, then hip strength and mobility.
program.about: Power behind every strike. One day pairs power bouts with explosive strength: clap push-ups, swings, thrusters and rotational work. The other pairs combination bouts with hip strength and a hip flow, because kicks start in the hips. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
program.split: Power bouts & explosive strength / bouts & hips
